title: Geometric Sequence Calculator
description: From the first term and common ratio get the nth term, the partial sum and the infinite sum when |r| < 1.
howto: Enter the first term a₁ and common ratio r.
Press Calculate for the nth term, partial sum and infinite sum.

faqs.a: Each term multiplies by the same ratio r: a₁, a₁·r, a₁·r², …

faqs.q: When does the infinite sum exist?
faqs.a: Only when |r| < 1 — then the terms shrink to zero and S∞ = a₁/(1−r).
Every term equals a₁, so the nth term is a₁ and the sum of n terms is n·a₁.
